About this space

Oak Ridge is a secluded 5-acre modern retreat in the pines — a remodeled 1,832-square-foot home that feels remote while staying convenient to downtown Nevada City, lake days, and river access.

Inside you’ll find three bedrooms and three bathrooms, plus a flexible downstairs sleeping room. Fiber internet, smart-lock entry, a full kitchen, in-home laundry, BBQ, fire pit, balcony, and forest views support both longer stays and weekend escapes.

Ideal for Bay Area couples, families, and friends seeking a Nevada City vacation rental with Scotts Flat Reservoir about 10 minutes away and South Yuba River nearby. Sugar Bowl is about 75 minutes for ski days.

Frequently asked questions

How many guests can stay?

Oak Ridge sleeps up to 8 guests across 3 bedrooms and a downstairs flex room with a fold-out couch.

Is there wifi?

Yes — fiber internet is available for remote work and streaming.

How far is downtown Nevada City?

About 15 minutes by car. Scotts Flat Reservoir is about 10 minutes; South Yuba River is nearby.

Can I get deliveries?

Yes — DoorDash and Instacart can reach the property.
